useCases: Token-Efficient & Accurate: Matches JSON's retrieval accuracy with fewer tokens – see Benchmarks.
JSON Data Model: Encodes the same objects, arrays, and primitives as JSON with deterministic, lossless round-trips.
LLM-Friendly Guardrails: `[N]` declares how many rows, `{fields}` how wide – so truncated or malformed output can't slip through.
